ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud schemes and identify patterns and connections between entities
questions: How are Medicaid fraud schemes financed?
What are the most common methods of payment?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and payments involved in Medicaid fraud schemes, we may be able to identify patterns and connections that can help us track down and prosecute those responsible.
